_comment: Restriction policy for Claude Code agents. 'ask' = human approval required. There is deliberately NO 'allow' list: tool grants live once in standards/claude-config/settings.json as bare tool names, rules from all scopes merge and evaluate deny -> ask -> allow, so a project 'allow' can never widen anything and only rots. See standards.md#permissions.
_comment_factory: The ask tier mirrors projects/factory/critical-files.json, which is also what the cage renders into Edit/Write deny rules for an external seat. Keep the two in step: a path that is critical enough to deny a caged worker is critical enough to ask a local one.
